title: ExecPlan: Keep only the CSS-normalised, all-ASV beta-diversity analysis
protocol: Living document following ~/.claude/PLANS.md. Each required section of that protocol is one top-level key here, in the same order.
status: DRAFT - awaiting user approval and four decisions (see open_decisions). No code has been changed.
purpose: The analysis currently reports beta diversity (how different the bacterial communities of samples are from each other) three ways, on three different sets of taxa, which produces three different answers for the same question. After this change there is one: Bray-Curtis distances on all 2,823 filtered ASVs after CSS normalisation, with its PERMANOVA table. The other two - the original top-100-ASV analysis and the genus-level CSS analysis - are removed so no figure or table can be mistaken for the reported result.

context_and_orientation.environment: R 4.3.2, Quarto 1.7.32. Repository root /Users/expeditoolimi/Documents/Southampton/Southampton/Seedling_metaanalysis. Nothing is committed since fdc30d9; the working tree holds all earlier uncommitted edits.

terms.ASV: Amplicon sequence variant: one exact 16S sequence type. 2,823 remain after filtering.
terms.CSS: Cumulative sum scaling (metagenomeSeq): a normalisation that scales each sample by the sum of its counts up to a data-driven quantile, used here instead of rarefaction because sequencing depth differs 65-fold between studies.
terms.PERMANOVA: Permutation test (vegan::adonis2) of whether groups differ in community composition; R2 is the share of variation a grouping explains.
terms.PERMDISP: Permutation test (vegan::betadisper) of whether groups differ in spread. PERMANOVA can be significant because of spread alone, so the two are read together.
terms.PCoA: Principal coordinates analysis: the 2-D scatter drawn from a distance matrix.
terms.univariate vs marginal: Univariate tests one grouping alone; marginal tests each grouping after accounting for all the others.

consequences_of_deleting: Every ordination figure by grouping variable is currently drawn from GENUS distances. Deleting the genus track leaves no ordination figure except one ASV-level panel, unless the figures are redrawn at ASV level (decision 1).
The only PERMDISP in the document belongs to the original top-100 track. Deleting it leaves the kept PERMANOVA with no dispersion test (decision 2).
NMDS, UMAP, UniFrac and Jaccard results disappear entirely; the kept analysis is Bray-Curtis only.

The per-variable beta tests in variable-assessment (top-100) go; the kept chunk already tests Developmental_Stage, Family, Scientific_Name, Cultivar, study_alias and Geography on all ASVs. Author is not among them.

The genus-level check - that the stage effect does not depend on the unit of analysis (it is larger at genus level, R2 = 0.038) - is lost. 57.4% of ASVs occur in a single study, so an ASV-level effect partly reflects study identity; the code comment that says this stays, but the supporting genus row goes.
not_touched: validation/verify_manuscript.py and Part 3 of the master (the independent audit and its figures) - deliberately separate; its tables of record describe the manuscript as audited.
microbiome_analysis.py and phyloseq_analysis.R (the Python pipeline) - it has its own genus-level beta diversity; out of scope unless decision 4 says otherwise.
filters.beta_top_taxa and analysis.beta_rank in the configs - still read by the Python pipeline.

plan_of_work: All code changes are in seedling_analysis_master.qmd. Work from the dependents inward so the document parses after every step: first the kept chunk is made self-sufficient (ASV-only, with its own ordination figures and, if approved, PERMDISP); then the consumers of the old results (summary, figure plan, captions, guidance text) are pointed at the kept outputs; only then are the old chunks removed, each replaced by an HTML comment '<!-- removed: <label> - <reason> -->' as was done for the alpha-diversity removal, so the history of what was there stays readable. Stale output files are deleted last, and only those listed under decision 3. Rollback: nothing is committed, so a snapshot commit is taken first if approved (decision 4); otherwise a copy of the master is kept in the scratchpad for the duration.

open_decisions.question: Ordination figures: redraw at ASV level, or have none?
open_decisions.recommended: Redraw at ASV level, so the figures and the reported PERMANOVA describe the same data.

open_decisions.question: Add a PERMDISP on the kept ASV distances?
open_decisions.recommended: Yes. Without it a reviewer cannot tell whether the PERMANOVA reflects a shift in composition or only a difference in spread.

open_decisions.question: Delete the stale output files listed in milestone 4, or leave them on disk?
open_decisions.recommended: Delete, so an old figure cannot be picked up as a current result.

open_decisions.question: Take a git snapshot commit before removing code?
open_decisions.recommended: Yes; the same was done before the alpha-diversity removal (commit fdc30d9).
